hardware.variant: Assembled kit; V1.2 reported by operator; ESP32-S31 silicon revision 0.0 read through ROM

inputs.name: RAM-only ESP32-S31 U-Boot SPL ROM image

scenario: Enter the vendor ROM download mode manually; use esptool to load the diagnostic SPL to RAM and observe the separate UART console. No firmware image was written to nonvolatile storage in this trial.
expected: SPL initializes the early cache, PMA, clocks and PSRAM, reports detected capacity and starts its UART receiver.
observed: The RAM-loaded SPL printed completion markers for cache/MMU, PSRAM PMA, MPLL, seven PSRAM mode-register SPI transactions, AXI and PSRAM MMU. It reported 16 MiB PSRAM density, printed readiness for UART FIT and emitted repeated receiver handshake characters.
limits: The density is the SPL interpretation of the PSRAM mode register; full-range PSRAM reads and writes were not tested.
Receiving or validating a FIT, U-Boot proper, OpenSBI, EmberBSD kernel boot and permanent installation were not tested.
This result applies to one operator-reported V1.2 sample and silicon revision 0.0; other boards and revisions were not tested.
RAM-only loading does not establish successful firmware restoration or persistence across power cycles.
The UART trace and device identifiers remain private; no private logs or raw identifiers are published.
